analysis_result.analysis: The model failed primarily due to a hallucination: it incorrectly perceived a seventh line being drawn at 0:09, when in fact the scene was clearing and the question was appearing. This perceptual error led directly to an incorrect final count of 7 instead of the correct 6. The model’s reasoning was otherwise logically consistent — it correctly identified each line as distinct and sequentially drawn — but the foundational perception was flawed. No other reasoning or identification errors were detected; the failure is rooted in misinterpreting the visual transition at the end of the scene.
